description: This file defines the `PcbMoveTool` class which provides functionality to read a PCB design from a file and move its elements by specified x and y offsets. It includes a main method for command-line usage and various static methods for processing PCB nodes and coordinates.

classes.name: PcbMoveTool
classes.description: Main class providing tools to move PCB elements within a design file by specified offsets.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point for command-line execution, expects source filename, destination filename, and X, Y offsets.

methods.name: readAndMove
methods.description: Reads a PCB file and applies movement offsets to its elements.

methods.name: move
methods.description: Performs movement of all relevant PCB nodes (lines, arcs, circles, texts, zones, segments, vias, modules) by specified dx and dy.

methods.name: movePts
methods.description: Moves the points in a polygon by applying coordinate shifts.

methods.name: moveStartEnd
methods.description: Moves start and end points of a segment.

methods.name: moveAt
methods.description: Moves the 'at' coordinate of a module or element.

methods.name: moveCoordinatesInFirstChildren
methods.description: Moves the first child coordinate node within a PCB node.

methods.name: moveCoordinates
methods.description: Helper method to shift coordinate values within a node.
